column1: Initialize a local Git repository at the chosen project or solution root with {{c1::git init}}.
column2:
Track the SQL source, project configuration, and reference data scripts together.
Review source

column1: Share repository-wide ignore patterns through a versioned {{c1::.gitignore}} file.
column2:
Exclude generated bin and obj folders, generated .dacpac files, and user settings, but existing tracked files remain tracked.
Review source

column1: Declare prep-db.sql as the pre-deployment entry script with {{c1::<PreDeploy Include="prep-db.sql" />}}.
column2:
Place this item inside an ItemGroup in the .sqlproj file.
Review source

column1: Declare PostDeploy.sql as the post-deployment entry script with {{c1::<PostDeploy Include="PostDeploy.sql" />}}.
column2:
The entry script can organize smaller seed files into the required execution order.
Review source

column1: Include a seed file in a deployment script with {{c1:::r}} .\Scripts\PostDeployment\seed-statuses.sql.
column2:
SQLCMD includes let one entry script execute multiple focused files in the listed order.
Review source

column1: Exclude seed.sql from SDK-style model compilation with {{c1::<Build Remove="seed.sql" />}}.
column2:
The file can still contribute to a deployment script through a SQLCMD include.
Review source

column1: After excluding seed.sql from compilation, keep it visible as a project item with {{c1::<None Include="seed.sql" />}}.
column2:
Place the item in the .sqlproj alongside its Build Remove entry.
Review source

column1: For MERGE aliases target and source, match rows by StatusID with {{c1::ON target.StatusID = source.StatusID}}.
column2:
Match on the stable key rather than a description that the seed script needs to change.
Review source

column1: In a reference data MERGE, update existing matches with {{c1::WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET}} followed by assignments.
column2:
For example, set target.StatusName = source.StatusName to synchronize the label for an existing key.
Review source

column1: In a reference data MERGE, insert source rows missing from the target with {{c1::WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT}}.
column2:
Supply the target columns and VALUES, and terminate the complete MERGE statement with a semicolon.
